fdr_note: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR (q=0.05) IS applied to the reversal family per (metric, load_region): family members are the tests that reached the pre-registered statistical-support stage (sign change + both margins pass); per-pair p = max(p_x, p_y) (intersection-union over both conditions) of the frozen block-bootstrap sign-test p-values. `supported_after_fdr` is the multiplicity-corrected supported-reversal flag.
